releases.releaseNotes:
# LightBroom 1.1.79 Beta

- LED output now uses SPI with DMA, matching SmartBeam's output method, to address LED flicker.
- Existing LED colours, brightness controls, animations and startup indications are retained.

This beta targets product 5.1 (LightBroom / Inner Light). It is a signed OTA update; it does not include a factory image.

# LightBroom 1.1.151 Beta

- Adds shared ten-second button-hold recovery and watchdog protection for stalled application workers.
- Bounds shutdown preparation and Bluetooth cleanup while preserving charging-only operation and button wake.
- Closes I2C transaction admission before reset cleanup, recovers and releases the bus when possible, and retains an independent reset deadline if cleanup stalls.
- Preserves standby intent across recovery resets and requires release before repeating a held-button recovery.
- Consolidates OTA confirmation, boot selection and reboot ownership. Busy commands preserve the accepted update result, and in-flight OTA worker operations have a watchdog deadline.
- Uses coherent cached OTA status so LED rendering no longer performs OTA flash reads.

Firmware build and host regression tests passed. This signed beta OTA package is offered through the alpha stream and does not include a factory image.

# LightBroom 1.1.159 Beta

- Allows the battery gauge's specified clock-stretch timing to avoid premature I2C timeouts.
- Coordinates shared-bus recovery with a cooldown and bounded retry backoff, while keeping other devices available when an absent device releases the bus.
- Preserves the previous gauge handle if a bus-speed change fails.
- Keeps gauge initialization able to recover a bus fault while preserving existing command pacing and packet timeouts.

Built from the Inner Light 1.1 branch. Shared-bus tests at 1000 Hz and 100 Hz, battery/startup tests, recovery regressions, and the firmware build passed. Electrical fault recovery has not been bench-tested. This signed beta OTA package is offered through the alpha stream and does not include a factory image.

# LightBroom 1.1.185 Beta

- Includes charging-only USB startup, asynchronous battery telemetry, SPI/DMA LED output and the revised Cylon/SOC startup presentation.
- Adds explicit startup readiness and phase timing, and blocks OTA confirmation when accelerometer or migration setup fails.
- Coordinates Bluetooth startup and shutdown while preserving independent power release, button wake and charging indication.
- Uses the latest shared components from SmartBroom, including battery and I2C recovery improvements.

Built from the November firmware integration source at commit 22b8917. All three product firmware builds and eight focused startup/shutdown host regression runners passed. Hardware verification has not been performed for this update. This signed beta OTA package is distributed through the alpha stream and contains no factory image.

# LightBroom 1.1.192 Beta

- Keeps charge completion latched for the USB connection through SOC dips and charger maintenance cycling.
- Shows a steady full green SOC bar after completion and keeps the 30-minute play-dead dark timer progressing through SOC dips.
- Clears completion when USB is removed; measured battery telemetry remains unchanged.

Signed beta OTA package for distribution through the alpha stream. Host regression tests passed for the battery changes; hardware validation has not been performed. Source, build configuration, release notes, signed artifacts and checksums are committed together in the firmware repository.

# LightBroom 1.1.197 Beta

- Uses ESP-IDF 6.1 across all three products, with the repository-maintained CMake private-header dependency correction.
- Aligns compiler, Newlib, stack protection, watchdog, network/TLS and Bluetooth settings with SmartBroom while preserving product identity and signing keys.
- Enables OTA rollback and 1000 Hz FreeRTOS ticks in every profile.
- Keeps PM/tickless support compiled in with automatic light sleep disabled at startup; runtime can opt in later. Dev USB monitoring prevents automatic light sleep while connected.
- Keeps the development bootloader silent and permanently disables ROM UART logging through the existing application-startup eFuse policy. App-only OTA does not replace the installed second-stage bootloader.

Clean development build completed with zero compiler, linker or CMake warnings. Config-policy regression checks passed across all nine profiles; firmware tooling tests passed. Upstream SDK Kconfig notices remain. Physical hardware and OTA migration validation have not been performed.

Signed beta OTA package for the alpha stream. Source, effective build configuration, SDK patch, release notes, signed artifact and checksums are committed together in the firmware repository. No SOC persistence was added.

# LightBroom 1.1.198 Beta

- Rebuilt against a verified clean, unmodified ESP-IDF v6.1 checkout.
- Removes automatic SDK patching and the private-header CMake patch from the firmware tooling.
- Retains the aligned compiler, Newlib, stack-protection, watchdog, BLE, network/TLS, OTA rollback and 1000 Hz settings.
- Keeps automatic light sleep disabled at startup with runtime support compiled in, and retains dev USB monitor sleep protection.

Clean build passed with zero compiler/linker warnings or errors. The five upstream Wi-Fi/supplicant CMake include-ownership warnings remain visible, along with SDK Kconfig notices. All nine configuration checks and 17 firmware tooling tests passed. Hardware/OTA migration validation has not been performed.

Signed beta OTA package for the alpha stream. Prior releases remain immutable. App-only OTA does not replace the installed second-stage bootloader. Source, effective build configuration, release notes, signed image and checksums are committed together in the firmware repository.
